features.name: OpenAI GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 family reroute date approaching
features.says: OpenAI GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 family model requests will be rerouted on April 14, 2027.

features.name: Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.7 Flash reroute date approaching
features.says: Gemini 3.6 Flash requests will be rerouted on March 1, 2027, and Gemini 3.7 Flash requests on March 31, 2027.

features.name: GPT-5 family and O3 / O3-Pro reroute date approaching
features.says: GPT-5 Family and O3 / O3-Pro model requests will be rerouted on December 11, 2026.

features.name: Azure OpenAI o3 family and o4-mini reroute date approaching
features.says: Azure OpenAI o3 family and o4-mini model requests will be rerouted on November 11, 2026.

features.name: Simplified agent metadata types
features.says: Starting in API version 68.0, the AiAgentDefinition and AiAgentDefinitionVersion types let Salesforce CLI retrieve an agent and all its dependencies automatically, replacing at least three metadata types and manual addition of dependencies.

features.name: Conversation-level test cases with context variables in Testing Center (Beta)
features.says: Context variables can be added when generating test cases or uploading a CSV file, so full conversations can be tested as the agent runs them.

features.name: Auto-Hangup on by default for Agentforce Voice agents
features.says: Auto-Hangup is now on by default so voice agents end calls when the caller's request is fully addressed; agents with explicit values keep them, and the connection-level setting is removed.

features.name: Automatic call ending and routing by disconnect reason for Agentforce Voice
features.says: Agents end calls when a caller stops responding or the maximum duration is reached, Auto-Hangup can be enabled per agent, and Auto Disconnect in Voice Setup returns control to partner telephony vendors with a disconnect reason.

features.name: Voice Call data mapping in Agentforce Analytics
features.says: Voice Call data can be mapped to the Agentforce Analytics Foundations data model and is added automatically when the Session Tracing Data Model is enabled.

features.name: Agentforce Builder reasoning engine change from GPT-4.1 to GPT-5.6 Luna
features.says: OpenAI is retiring GPT-4.1 near March 2027, so agents' reasoning engines should be upgraded to GPT-5.6 Luna before then, with thorough testing required.

features.name: Context variable values in Testing Center test generation
features.says: Context variable values entered during setup are filled in across generated test cases and can be edited in the test suite or CSV file.

features.name: Agentforce assistant renamed Agent Optimizer (Beta)
features.says: The integrated AI assistant in Agentforce Builder is renamed Agent Optimizer, with the chat heading, Ask Optimizer button, and Disable Agentforce Optimizer (Beta) setting updated accordingly.

features.name: Org-wide control of conversational memory
features.says: A single setting turns conversational memory off for all agents and users; existing memories are preserved but unused while off, and the Memory & Preferences icon is hidden.

features.name: Legacy Agent Builder reasoning engine change from GPT-4o to GPT-5.6 Luna
features.says: The legacy Agentforce Builder adds an on/off switch to change the reasoning engine to GPT-5.6 Luna on October 15, 2026.

features.name: Reusable skills for Agentforce Coworker (Beta)
features.says: Skills package instructions, context, and tools into reusable multi-step workflows, created and published in Skill Builder and run from Skills in Agentforce Coworker.

features.name: Unified Sessions and Intents view
features.says: Processed and unprocessed sessions can be reviewed together, views can be saved, and sessions can be evaluated or exported from one workspace.

features.name: Real-Time Streaming for Agentforce Voice call transfers
features.says: Amazon Connect can stream call audio directly to Agentforce over a WebSocket connection, removing the need for a dedicated static phone number or SIP trunk configuration.

features.name: Plain-language building and analysis with Grid Agent
features.says: Grid Agent in the sidebar, open by default, configures Agentforce Grid columns and answers data questions from plain-language requests after the user approves the proposed action.

features.name: Error mode default for agent file uploads
features.says: Agents that can receive file uploads now default to error mode, sending a customizable error message; accepting uploads requires adding the file upload parameter with a mode to the agent script.

features.name: New rate limits and model access rules for free and trial orgs
features.says: New rate limits and model access rules may affect Developer Edition orgs, Trailhead Playgrounds, and other free and trial orgs.

features.name: Conditional logic in Prompt Templates generally available
features.says: If, else if, and else blocks in generative AI prompt templates are generally available so one template can adapt based on grounded data.

features.name: Grounding Prompt Templates with Office, text, and email files
features.says: Prompt templates can ground generative AI requests with Word, spreadsheet, presentation, text, CSV, and email files in addition to PDF and image files.

features.name: See knowledge sources in Agentforce session details
features.says: Agentforce sessions show the Salesforce Knowledge articles and external sources an agent used, viewable by opening a session from Sessions & Intents.

features.name: Track voice latency and speech metrics in Session Trace
features.says: Session Trace surfaces long Agentforce Voice silences, speech-to-text and text-to-speech timing, and word-level ASR confidence, with a clock icon flagging abnormal agent silence.

features.name: Updated Agentforce Observability metric names and formulas
features.says: Several Observability metric names and formulas changed, Success Rate uses an updated calculation, and Agent Interaction Duration is removed from dashboard templates.

features.name: Dynamic default model selection for new agents
features.says: Starting October 15, 2026, new agents created in Agentforce Builder default to an optimal model selected for them.

features.name: Per-user authentication to external MCP servers (beta or pilot status not stated)
features.says: Agentforce Employee agents can act on behalf of individual users with user-based MCP servers, so users connect with their own credentials instead of a shared system-to-system connection.

features.name: Agent memory (generally available)
features.says: Agentforce agents recall relevant details from users' past conversations and reference profile details such as a user's name from the first message, so users don't restate information.

features.name: Global expansion of Dynamic Routing for Agentforce Voice
features.says: Local phone numbers for Dynamic Routing are being continuously added in more countries throughout this release.

features.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro, Flash, and Flash-Lite reroute on October 20, 2026
features.says: Requests to Gemini 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash reroute to Gemini 3.5 Flash, and 2.5 Flash-Lite reroutes to Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, on October 20, 2026; testing prompts beforehand is recommended because responses can change.

features.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash generally available
features.says: Gemini 3.8 Flash is ready for production with a rate limit of 1,000 requests per minute and can be used in any supported feature, such as prompt templates.

features.name: Agentforce assistant tests agent changes (Beta)
features.says: The Agentforce assistant automatically runs simulate-mode previews to validate its suggested changes against edge cases and iterates until the agent behaves as expected, and can also test user-made changes on request.

features.name: Upgrade Einstein bots to Agentforce Service Agent (generally available)
features.says: The Upgrade Agent tool converts an Einstein Bot into an Agentforce Service Agent, creating the new agent separately so the existing bot stays available during review.

features.name: File uploads for Agentforce Service and Employee agents
features.says: Agents support file uploads in production and preview conversations, letting users attach screenshots, receipts, and PDFs that agents can interpret, add to records, or use as context, on Enhanced Chat v1, v2, and Lightning Experience.

features.name: Preview custom Lightning types for actions in Agentforce builder
features.says: Custom Lightning types now render in preview for actions created or customized in an agent, regardless of where they were made or whether the agent is in draft or committed state.

features.name: Continue ended sessions in Enhanced Chat v2
features.says: Customers can resume a timed-out or ended messaging session in Enhanced Chat v2 by clicking Continue Conversation.

features.name: Control how agent action outputs appear on a connection
features.says: The render nested inline action sets a consistent output format per connection, JSON output passes structured data directly, and show_and_return ends reasoning after an action sends a response.

features.name: Field generation refinements respect the selected model
features.says: Follow-up and refinement responses are generated from the model selected in the field generation prompt template instead of the Salesforce default LLM.

features.name: Validate field generation refinements setting
features.says: A new Setup setting validates field generation follow-up requests for business relevance, limiting the agent to field generation activity and conserving Einstein credits.

features.name: Connection instructions for channel-specific agent behavior
features.says: Customizable connection instructions guide agent reasoning and responses on Messaging, Service Email, or Marketing Email connections.

features.name: Dynamic messaging components for custom response formats
features.says: Custom response formats can use enhanced link, static and dynamic question, time selector, and form components, populated with agent action output.

features.name: Compare and merge agent versions in Agentforce Builder
features.says: Two agent versions can be compared and changes merged from one into another in Canvas and Script view.

features.name: Custom SIP headers and REFER disconnect for Agentforce Voice
features.says: Custom SIP X-headers from inbound calls can carry context such as intent, language, or case history, and escalation flows can return or modify headers using SIP REFER on disconnect or transfer.

features.name: Dynamic Routing for Agentforce Voice available in Japan
features.says: Dynamic Routing supports local phone numbers in Japan, reached by calling the reserveRoutableNumber API and forwarding the call to the local number.

features.name: Agentforce platform enabled by default
features.says: The Agentforce platform is enabled by default for all orgs with Agentforce access, new orgs at creation and existing orgs automatically, with the Setup setting removed at no added cost.

features.name: Enforced limit on procured Agentforce Voice phone numbers
features.says: Agentforce Voice enforces the Salesforce Voice (Native Telephony) phone number limit: set by license in production, and 10 in sandbox and trial orgs.

features.name: Full conversation history in post-call voice transcripts
features.says: The Enhance Conversation component shows both agent-customer and rep-customer transcripts on the VC1 voice call record after a transferred call ends, matching what was visible during the call.

features.name: Pause and resume call recording via Toolkit API
features.says: The Salesforce Voice Toolkit API can pause and resume call recordings without the Control Call Recording permission, which is still required for the Salesforce UI controls.

features.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash generally available
features.says: The Gemini 3.7 Flash model is ready for production use with a rate limit of 1,000 requests per minute, and can be used for functionality such as prompt templates.

features.name: Multi-Agent orchestration (generally available)
features.says: Agentforce agents can be connected with other specialized Agentforce agents in the same org to collaborate on complex tasks, extending an agent's capabilities.

features.name: Gemini 3.6 Flash generally available
features.says: The Gemini 3.6 Flash model is ready for production use with a rate limit of 1,000 requests per minute, and can be used for functionality such as prompt templates.

features.name: Status indicator for guidance service plan creation
features.says: Service reps see a status indicator in the component showing that a service plan is being created, so they know work is in progress before the plan summary appears.

features.product: New and Changed Standard Agent Actions and Subagents
features.name: New and changed standard agent actions and subagents
features.says: New and changed standard agent actions and subagents can be added to an agent to quickly extend its functionality.

features.name: Quick Pages (beta)
features.says: Users describe a custom page in natural language, and an agent builds a React-based UI grounded in Salesforce data that pulls information from multiple objects and fields into one shareable view.

features.name: Fundraising setup with agents
features.says: Admins and partners can ask an AI agent to turn on Fundraising, assign permission sets, create a default gift designation, and enable related features, including optional enhanced features, instead of working through multiple Setup pages.

features.name: Volunteer Management setup with agents
features.says: AI agents can turn on Volunteer Management, assign permission sets, configure initiatives, create records, and run day-to-day tasks from the command line or another agent channel, previously done in the Salesforce UI.

features.name: Salesforce context in Claude (beta)
features.says: Deal health, pipeline risk, and account context from live org data appear in a Claude conversation through a secure Salesforce MCP connection and pre-built skills; the beta is read-only at launch.

features.name: Create and update records in Salesforce in Claude (beta)
features.says: Users can create and update Salesforce records directly from Claude, with field-level validation rules enforced as in Lightning Experience, where previously activity was read-only or only created drafts.

features.name: Query 10 more Setup objects with Setup agent
features.says: The Setup agent answers natural-language questions about 10 more Setup objects, including ApexClass, ApexPage, and PlatformEventChannel.

features.name: Metadata grounding MCP server (beta)
features.says: The server gives AI agents semantic understanding of org metadata, letting development agents discover and reuse objects, fields, LWCs, permission sets, flows, and Apex classes through natural-language queries against Salesforce Catalog.

features.name: Data Cloud required again for Setup with Agentforce
features.says: Data Cloud is no longer an optional prerequisite in the Setup with Agentforce enablement process because of changes to how the feature works.

features.name: Define and customize promotions with an AI coding assistant
features.says: Natural-language instructions in an AI coding environment configure promotion creation, updates, and copies through the Promotion Business Object API, replacing manual workflow creation, entity registration, and JSON editing.

features.name: Enroll loyalty members and manage cases with AI tools
features.says: Service representatives and marketing managers can enroll members and manage tiers, points, and vouchers through natural-language prompts, with each request processed independently.

features.name: Set up loyalty programs with AI tools
features.says: A conversational workflow creates a loyalty program with its tier model, currencies, accrual and redemption activities, tier benefits, and tier assessment rules, then activates it.

features.name: Content Read-Only MCP server (generally available)
features.says: The Content Read-Only MCP server is now generally available, expanding from 3 tools for image and brand content to 18 tools covering many CMS content types and resources.

features.name: Content Write MCP server
features.says: The Content Write MCP server provides 15 tools to create and manage enhanced CMS workspaces, content, variants, folders, and channels.

features.name: Explore 124 more Setup objects with Setup agent
features.says: The Setup agent gains read-only access to 124 additional Setup objects, including OpportunitySplitType, AccountRelationshipShareRule, and ContentAsset, but cannot create, update, or delete them.

features.name: Agentforce Commerce vibes for B2C Commerce
features.says: A VS Code extension provides an autonomous agent that understands storefront projects and B2C Commerce instances to delegate multistep development tasks for Storefront Next, SFRA, and PWA Kit storefronts.

features.name: Configure agency billing with an AI coding assistant
features.says: A coding agent guides configuration of agency billing from a plain-language outcome, with selectable review levels, covering legal entities, billing, tax, payment, accounting, permissions and license checks, then creates a verification policy.

features.name: Analyze Agentforce Vibes usage with the Agentic Development dashboard (Developer Preview)
features.says: The Agentic Development dashboard tracks Agentforce Vibes data across orgs, requires turning on the DevOps Center Analytics tab, offers more granular model usage data, and can enable Developer-Level Insights for individual user analytics.

features.name: Automate managed package post-install configuration with an AI Skill
features.says: The dx-pkg-post-install-configure AI Skill automates post-install configuration for any managed package from an AI coding client using plain-language prompts.

features.name: Create trial orgs with AI Skills
features.says: Two AI Skills let developers create trial, Developer Edition and Trialforce orgs from natural-language prompts and track when those orgs expire.

features.name: Track trial org expiration with AI Skills
features.says: Two AI Skills let developers track when their trial, Developer Edition and Trialforce orgs expire.

features.name: Create and manage Scratch Orgs with AI Skills
features.says: Five AI Skills create and manage scratch orgs, org shapes and scratch org snapshots from natural-language prompts.

features.name: Compare Scratch Orgs for drift with AI Skills
features.says: AI Skills compare scratch orgs for drift from natural-language prompts.

features.name: Track Scratch Org expiration with AI Skills
features.says: AI Skills track scratch org expiration from natural-language prompts.

features.name: Expand the Salesforce Development plugin with specialized capabilities and guided workflows
features.says: Guided workflows combine AI Skills, Salesforce CLI, hosted MCP servers, agents, hooks and commands for building, testing and deploying, with developers approving each plugin installation and reviewing proposed changes.

features.name: Manage Dev Hub from your coding client with an AI Skill
features.says: The new dx-org-devhub-configure AI Skill enables and manages Dev Hub from an AI coding client using natural-language prompts.

features.name: Create, refresh and activate sandboxes with AI Skills
features.says: Three AI Skills create, refresh and activate sandboxes from natural-language prompts.

features.name: Generate and apply post-copy configuration files with AI Skills
features.says: AI Skills generate and apply post-copy configuration files for sandboxes from natural-language prompts.

features.name: Automate SLA management setup and maintenance
features.says: The sla-management-setup skill creates SLA policies, milestone types, milestones and milestone actions, activates policies, defines entitlement auto-application conditions, and manages policy versions and rules.

features.name: Configure SMS messaging channels with a headless Claude skill
features.says: The service_de_headless_sms_configure skill sets up an Enhanced SMS channel, covering auto-response messages, consent, channel activation and routing in one guided workflow across APIs and configuration pages.

features.name: Create and update Enhanced Chat channels with AI Skills
features.says: The service-digital-engagement-channel-configure skill creates, updates and deploys a headless Enhanced Chat channel from natural-language instructions, including routing, verification and pre-chat fields, without the UI wizard.

features.name: Generate Embedded Service deployments with AI skills
features.says: The service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure skill generates an Embedded Service Deployment and a starting embed code snippet for a website or app.

features.name: Set up Email-to-Case in one guided workflow
features.says: The Headless 360 agent configures case-handling prerequisites, Email-to-Case settings and routing address from a support address and case owner choice, replacing a multipage setup and repeatable for each service email address.

features.name: Combined Setup with Agentforce User Permission Set Group
features.says: A new Setup with Agentforce User permission set group combines the Use Setup with Agentforce and Prompt Template User permissions, replacing the need to assign two separate permission sets.

features.name: Redesigned Setup with Agentforce enablement page
features.says: A streamlined, guided enablement page helps admins manage prerequisites, features and permissions for Setup with Agentforce in fewer steps.

features.name: Read access to 190+ additional Setup objects with the Setup agent
features.says: The Setup agent can answer natural-language questions about over 190 more Setup objects, including AuthConfig, RevenueSourceObjectConfig and UiFormulaRule, with read access only and no create, update or delete.

features.name: Bulk user actions with the Setup agent
features.says: The Setup agent performs bulk actions on multiple selected or all users, such as freezing users or resetting passwords, or acts on users identified by description, limited to the User object.

features.name: Profile access summary with Setup with Agentforce
features.says: Users can ask whether a named profile grants object access, field-level security, user permissions, custom permissions or external client application access, or which profiles grant a given permission, without navigating Setup pages.

features.name: Permission Set, profile and Permission Set Group summaries in Setup with Agentforce
features.says: Agentforce for Setup summarizes permission sets, profiles and permission set groups in chat, including object access, field permission counts, high-risk permissions, assigned user counts, and permission set group net effect of muting permission sets.

features.name: Create and update user roles with Setup with Agentforce
features.says: Agentforce for Setup can create a user role or update an existing one from a described need, presenting a recommendation for review and confirmation before saving to the org.

features.name: Summarize org admins' security compliance in Setup with Agentforce
features.says: Users can ask Setup with Agentforce in natural language for a summary of org compliance with phishing-resistant MFA mandates, checking users with System Administrator profile or Modify All Data, View All Data, Customize Application, or Author Apex permissions.

features.name: Send reset password emails and freeze accounts for multiple users
features.says: Setup with Agentforce can send reset password emails to groups of users and freeze or unfreeze several user accounts at once, actions previously limited to one user at a time.

features.name: Plan, build, and preview apps and agents with Salesforce Builder Central (Beta)
features.says: Builder Central lets users describe an app or agent in plain language, then plan, build, preview it in a workspace, validate it in a preview org, and deploy to a sandbox.

features.name: Create a messaging channel with a headless Claude skill
features.says: The service_de_headless_channel_configure skill configures a Facebook, WhatsApp, LINE, or Apple Messages for Business channel across multiple applications, including APIs and routing, in minutes instead of over 15 minutes.

features.name: Equip your AI coding agent with AI Skills
features.says: AI Skills give AI coding agents expertise in Lightning Web Components, Flow, and Apex; they can be added from the sf-skills repository to Claude Code, Codex, or other CLIs, and are installed and updated automatically in Agentforce Vibes.

features.name: Explore over 100 additional objects in Setup with Agentforce
features.says: The Setup agent gains read access to over 100 additional Setup objects, including AIApplication, AuraDefinitionBundle, and LightningComponentBundle, but cannot create, update, or delete them.

features.name: Configure Document AI faster with the Data 360 MCP server
features.says: An AI agent such as Claude or Cursor connected to the Data 360 MCP server can build, test, and activate Document AI configurations and publish document schemas through natural-language conversation.

features.name: Generate flow test scenarios with Agentforce for Flow Headless
features.says: Agentforce for Flow Headless drafts test scenarios, including success, fault, and edge-case paths, for record-triggered, autolaunched, and Data Cloud-triggered flows from a connected terminal.

features.name: Set up pipeline management with the Pipeline Management configuration skill
features.says: A configuration skill takes natural-language instructions to set up text fields on opportunities, and reps can approve AI suggestions in Pipeline Inspection or admins can enable autonomous mode for the agent to apply updates.

features.name: Set up a Help Agent in one guided workflow
features.says: The service-helpagent-coordinate skill runs one guided workflow that configures agent setup, knowledge grounding, Enhanced Chat deployment, escalation routing, and testing for a Service Cloud Help Agent.

features.name: Organize flows with flow tags
features.says: Classify flows with tags reflecting a business domain, team, or purpose, then filter the flows list view by tag; create tag categories and tag flows from the list view or the Tags tab.

features.name: Delete approval submission records to meet GDPR requirements
features.says: Salesforce cancels related in-progress approval submissions at 3:00 AM org instance time when a parent record is deleted, after which you can manually delete the submission records and their child records.

features.name: Find a record in a collection without loop elements
features.says: A Collection Filter Criteria resource with filter and sort criteria returns the first matching record without looping, and can filter on child relationships for records containing related records.

features.name: Build flows through conversation with Flow Author (Beta)
features.says: Describe what you want a flow to do and Flow Author generates a deployable flow from your confirmed intent, supporting autolaunched, record-triggered, schedule-triggered, and screen flows.

features.name: Validate text field length in Flow Builder
features.says: Flow Builder shows a warning at design and save time when a Create Record or Update Record element sets a field to a text value exceeding its length limit, identifying the field and value.

features.name: Control which objects guest and community users can query in OmniStudio
features.says: Omnistudio blocks SOQL and SOSL queries from external users through HandleData() and HandleDataCards() unless all objects are on a maintained allowlist, and allowed queries run in user mode.

features.name: Automatic retry on record lock errors in flows
features.says: Flows retry once after a 10-second wait when a record lock error occurs during transaction initialization, applying to schedule-triggered flows with run-time API version 62.0 or lower.

features.name: Newly added third-party connectors for MuleSoft for Flow
features.says: Newly added third-party connectors can be used in flows for no-code connectivity to external systems and data exchange between systems.

features.name: Automatic New and Outdated badges for approval work items
features.says: The Orchestration Work Guide automatically shows New badges on new approval work items and disables completed ones with an Outdated badge, which remain until the page is left or refreshed.

features.name: Automatic New and Outdated badges for orchestration work items
features.says: The Orchestration Work Guide automatically shows New badges on new orchestration work items and disables completed ones with an Outdated badge, which remain until the page is left or refreshed.

features.name: AI Relationship Research insights in Agentforce conversations
features.says: The Agentforce AI Relationship Research agent identifies key people and companies connected to an account or contact, explains each relationship with evidence, and recommends whom to engage.

features.name: Reactive formulas in conditional visibility rules
features.says: Reactive formulas can be referenced directly in conditional visibility rules for flow screens, including formulas that use components on the same screen.

features.name: Debug, suspend, and resume flow approval processes
features.says: Approval admins can suspend, resume, and debug approval submissions and their orchestration runs, with the Debug action giving run-specific diagnostics for in-progress, suspended, and errored submissions.

features.name: Contains operator for multi-select picklists in flow elements
features.says: The Contains operator on multi-select picklist fields now works in Get Records, Delete Records, Update Records, and schedule-triggered flow entry criteria, where it previously caused a run-time error.

features.name: Auto-generated element labels in Flow Builder
features.says: Flow Builder automatically generates and updates element labels from configured properties, preserving any labels you edit manually.

features.name: Private sharing for approval work item visibility
features.says: The sharing model can be set to private so reviewers at one step cannot view work items assigned to other steps, with read access granted through criteria-based sharing rules on the approval work item object.

features.name: Third-party connector actions in any flow
features.says: Third-party connector actions can be used in any flow to integrate with an external system for specific connectors.

features.name: Unused resources filter in Flow Builder Toolbox
features.says: A new Unused filter in the Flow Builder Toolbox narrows the resource list to items with no recorded usage so unneeded resources can be found and removed.

features.name: On-canvas flow performance monitoring
features.says: Flow performance data is viewable directly on the Flow Builder canvas to identify bottlenecks; embedded analytics are not available for screen flows or Flow Orchestration.

features.name: Multiple flow approval processes on the Request Approvals component
features.says: The Request Approvals component can give submitters up to 10 autolaunched flow approval processes to select from.

features.name: Split by Date and Split by Field Value decision types
features.says: Decision elements can route records using Split by Date and Split by Field Value types, choosing a field and configuring paths with inline pickers instead of expressions.

features.name: Version comparison for Data 360 and Agentforce Marketing flows
features.says: Flow Version Comparison supports Data 360-triggered flows and Agentforce Marketing flow types, including segment-triggered, automation event-triggered, and API event-triggered flows, across all audience sources, in table and canvas views.

features.name: Keyboard navigation and shortcuts in Flow Builder
features.says: Arrow keys move through the auto-layout canvas element to element, including across fault and branching paths, and standard shortcuts cut, copy, and paste elements.

features.name: Test flows with primitive collection inputs
features.says: Primitive collections can be populated directly in the Flow Builder debugger to test different input values, such as a text collection of IDs, without editing the flow.

features.name: Test flows with specific records by record ID
features.says: A static 15- or 18-character record ID can be entered in the Flow Builder debugger to debug flows with specific records, useful for objects with limited searchability such as Cases or Campaign Members.

features.name: Group elements in Flow Builder
features.says: Related elements can be organized into named, collapsible groups with labels and descriptions to simplify complex flows.

features.name: Null value handling in CSV-based decision tables
features.says: Empty cells in CSV-based decision tables are stored as null, the literal string "null" is treated as invalid, and empty boolean cells default to false; existing CSV files may need updating.

features.name: Flow Builder in the Salesforce Cosmos theme
features.says: Flow Builder is available in the modern Salesforce Cosmos theme with a denser canvas and Edit History for tracking flow changes over time.

features.name: Flow save-time error handling updates
features.says: Field length violations and missing required fields in Create Records elements are caught at save time, scheduled flows use dynamic batch sizing to reduce limit failures, and flows hitting record lock contention retry automatically.

features.name: Screen Flow updates: mass Quick Action, Time component, reactive formulas
features.says: Screen flows can run from a mass quick action on a list view or related list to process multiple records, a new Time screen component captures time values, and reactive formulas can be referenced in conditional visibility rules.

features.name: Trigger order confirmation flows with a REST API
features.says: Order confirmation flows can be triggered directly with a REST API to send transactional messages in seconds instead of minutes.

features.name: Flow Marketing cloud Marketing Object record elements
features.says: Flows can read, create, update, and delete Marketing Object records using standard Flow record elements.

features.name: Copy an audience flow without disrupting live campaigns
features.says: An audience flow can be copied without disrupting live campaigns.

features.name: Flow Test Mode (beta)
features.says: Flow Test Mode (beta) lets admins debug flows and save reusable test scenarios in one place for record-triggered and autolaunched flows.

features.name: Isolated flow testing with mock outputs
features.says: Flows can be tested in isolation with mock outputs for Action and Subflow elements.

features.name: Headless Agentforce for Flow test generation from the command line
features.says: Flow test scenarios can be generated from the command line with headless Agentforce for Flow.

features.name: Static record ID for debugging
features.says: A static record ID can be entered to debug flows with specific records.

features.name: Populate inputs to test more scenarios
features.says: Primitive and record collection inputs can be populated to test more scenarios.

features.name: Versioned flow runtime updates for API version 68.0
features.says: Versioned updates are available for flows configured to run on API version 68.0.

features.name: Automatically Open Next Work Item for flow approval processes
features.says: Users can move to the next work item from the same running flow approval process without returning to the list view, via the Automatically Open Next Work Item option in Lightning App Builder and Experience Builder.

features.name: Synchronous background steps in flow approval processes
features.says: Background steps calling synchronous actions run synchronously, reducing latency; existing processes need API version 68.0 or later to benefit.

features.name: Dedicated channel for record-change events in flow approval processes
features.says: Running flow approval processes route record-change events to a dedicated channel, reducing traffic in the step-completion channel. This is automatic.

features.name: Automatically Open Next Work Item for orchestrations
features.says: Users can move to the next work item from the same orchestration run without returning to the list view, via the Automatically Open Next Work Item option in Lightning App Builder and Experience Builder.

features.name: Synchronous background steps in orchestrations
features.says: Background steps calling synchronous actions run synchronously, reducing latency; existing orchestrations need API version 68.0 or later to benefit.

features.name: Dedicated channel for record-change events in orchestrations
features.says: Orchestration runs route record-change events to a dedicated channel, reducing traffic in the step-completion channel. This is automatic.

features.name: Single-flow review of extracted document data
features.says: Reviewers can verify and correct extracted document data within a single flow, which pauses at Extract Data from Document and resumes after corrections are submitted.

features.name: Confidence-threshold review routing
features.says: Admins can send every extraction for review, or only low-confidence extractions, based on thresholds in document processing configuration.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: AI Relationship Research (AI-powered relationship intelligence)
features.says: AI Relationship Research automatically discovers and analyzes relationships between people and organizations connected to Salesforce records, scanning CRM records, public web content, and Data 360, and presents top-ranked connections within the workflow.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Expression sets and decision tables as Agentforce actions
features.says: Expression sets and decision tables can be run as actions in Agentforce.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: List Branch element for expression sets
features.says: The List Branch element builds if-then-else rule conditions on list data in context-aware expression sets.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Multiple decision table outcomes in standard expression sets
features.says: Standard expression sets can process multiple decision table outcomes, even without Context Service.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Picklist dropdowns in expression set conditions
features.says: Picklist values can be selected from a dropdown instead of typed in expression set conditions.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Decision tables called directly from Omniscripts
features.says: Decision tables can be called directly from Omniscripts.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Faster decision table refreshes
features.says: Decision table refreshes are faster through parallel processing and automatic incremental refreshes.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Expanded data types and null handling in CSV decision tables
features.says: CSV-based decision tables support more data types and manage null values and empty cells, and each table's status is visible from the list view.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Setup Audit Trail for context definitions
features.says: Create, update, and delete actions across context definitions, nodes, attributes, mappings, and filters are tracked in Setup Audit Trail.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Multilevel DMO hierarchy hydration in Context Service
features.says: Context Service resolves parent-child relationships between Data 360 DMOs and returns complete multilevel hierarchies in a single hydration call, including zero-copy DMOs backed by external warehouses.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Faster Data Processing Engine runs with failure tracking
features.says: Definitions run faster, partial failures can be tracked, and active definition runs are protected from interruption.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: Parent record rollup totals and layered calculations
features.says: Admins decide whether parent records count toward rollup totals, and layered calculations can be kept together in one place.

features.product: Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries
features.name: OmniStudio low-code suite
features.says: Omnistudio provides a low-code suite of services and components for building industry-specific digital experiences that use Salesforce and external data.

features.name: Companion sandbox connection without manual metadata cleanup
features.says: Companion sandboxes created or refreshed after October 09, 2026 can usually retain metadata when connecting to a Data Cloud One Home org sandbox, removing manual metadata cleanup.

features.name: Bulk disable fields to fix Salesforce CRM connector data stream errors
features.says: Data streams in error status or failing to refresh can be fixed by reviewing fields, identifying those with errors, and disabling them in bulk; permission changes and field deletions commonly cause these errors.

features.name: Data access policies scoped by user attributes
features.says: Data access policies can be scoped to users by standard attributes such as Department, Division, or Profile ID, and by custom user fields like Region__c for object- and field-level policies, with access following each user's attributes.

features.name: Mask sensitive data in unstructured files (Generally Available)
features.says: Sensitive information in PDFs, text documents and HTML files can be tagged and masked with dynamic policies that redact or nullify values, using LLMs instead of traditional PII detection, with custom tags, taxonomies, more languages and tagging statistics in Tag Manager.

features.name: Salesforce Catalog (generally available)
features.says: Salesforce Catalog, powered by Data 360, extracts, ingests and indexes metadata so users and AI agents can discover objects, fields and LWCs through natural language, accessed via the Metadata Grounding MCP server in AI interfaces.

features.name: Extract structured data from text and markdown files with Document AI
features.says: Document AI natively reads plain text (.txt) and markdown (.md) files and extracts structured data, for both batch and transactional processing.

features.name: Process encrypted data with Document AI
features.says: Document AI processes data in orgs with Shield Platform Encryption and automatically protects data at rest with Salesforce-managed keys and BYOK service without additional setup.

features.name: Index conversation transcripts with intelligent chunking
features.says: Conversation-based chunking can index conversation transcripts so AI agents retrieve accurate responses, grouping all messages in a conversation; previously it applied only to audio and video files.

features.name: Data 360 credits for enriched indexing
features.says: Building an Enriched Search Index now reports usage against the Intelligent Processing usage type, whereas LLM calls for enriched chunks were previously billed under Agentforce Generative AI as Standard Prompts.

features.name: Build Data 360 retrievers with custom SQL queries
features.says: Retrievers can be defined, tested and created with SQL directly in the retriever UI, using parameterized queries against DMOs, DLOs and Calculated Insights.

features.name: Test inactive retrievers and versions in Retriever Playground
features.says: Inactive retrievers and retriever versions can be tested in Retriever Playground before activation, with metrics viewable as cards or tables; previously only active retrievers could be tested.

features.name: Advanced retriever metrics for RAG evaluation
features.says: Advanced mode in Retriever Playground, given a question and reference answer, generates a context precision score measuring how well relevant chunks rank above irrelevant ones.

features.name: Schedule secondary index refreshes with incremental rebuilds
features.says: Each secondary index's refresh frequency can be chosen, and only changed portions are rebuilt instead of the full index, reducing refresh cost and freshness lag; previously all indexes were fully rebuilt daily.

features.name: Distinct metadata and refresh status indicators for data graphs
features.says: Data graphs show separate status indicators for metadata and refresh processes, clarifying their state and whether they are ready to be queried.

features.name: Prevent duplicate matches in data graph refresh
features.says: Empty strings on text join keys are treated like nulls during data graph refresh, so empty keys no longer match each other, removing duplicate matches and improving refresh reliability.

features.name: Edit streaming data graphs with incremental changes
features.says: Streaming data graphs can be edited after creation to add or adjust related objects and attributes through incremental changes without rebuilding.

features.name: Create and manage segments with the Data 360 MCP server
features.says: Segments can be created, updated and published by describing the audience to an AI client connected to the Data 360 MCP server, which builds filters, counts members and publishes.

features.name: Send data action events to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
features.says: Amazon Kinesis can be a data action target, sending create, update and delete change data capture events from Data 360 to a Kinesis data stream for downstream processing.

features.name: Filter population breakdown for segment validation
features.says: Segment builder can generate a breakdown comparing the individual and cumulative impact of each Include and Exclude filter side by side, with running audience counts.

features.name: Consistent segment publish schedules across time zone changes
features.says: Publish schedules preserve local wall-clock time when the org time zone or daylight saving time changes, with expanded guidance on which changes trigger a segment save and how DST affects schedules.

features.name: View all companion connection eligibility errors at once
features.says: When a companion org connection fails eligibility checks, all unmet conditions are displayed together so all issues can be fixed before retrying.

features.name: Connect Data 360 to Databricks on Azure with Private Connect
features.says: Private Connect Multicloud establishes a private connection between Data 360 and Databricks on Azure, with Salesforce provisioning and maintaining the Azure private endpoints so data stays off the public internet.

features.name: Render source documents consistently for Intelligent Context citations
features.says: Source content can be harmonized into a single schema so citations open in-app and highlight the specific text chunk in the source document.

features.name: Redeploy data kits containing data graphs
features.says: Data kits with deployed data graphs can be redeployed without errors; unchanged data graphs are left as is and marked successful, making repeated deployments reliable.

features.name: Use attribute shortcuts from segmentation in activation
features.says: Attribute shortcuts created in the segment builder are available in both attribute and filter workflows on the activation canvas, keeping attribute definitions consistent.

features.name: Segment and activate audiences with the Data 360 Marketing Agent
features.says: The Data 360 Marketing Agent builds segment audiences from a natural-language description in the Agentforce panel, either creating a new segment or adding filters to the open segment canvas.

features.name: Build a segment by describing it
features.says: Describe an audience in natural language and the Data 360 Marketing Agent produces matching filter criteria, creating a new segment or adding filters to the open segment, including nested segments and calculated insights.

features.name: Schedule clean room queries to run on segment publish
features.says: Schedule a query to run automatically each time its consumer segment publishes, keeping clean room insights current, but only for Salesforce-provided collaboration templates.

features.name: Ingest Microsoft OneNote content into Data 360 (Generally Available)
features.says: The Microsoft OneNote Unstructured connector ingests notebook pages and embedded attachments from SharePoint team notebooks into Data 360 to power AI and search experiences.

features.name: Configure Document AI with the Data 360 MCP server
features.says: Build, test, and activate Document AI configurations through natural-language conversation with an AI agent such as Claude or Cursor connected to the Data 360 MCP server, including generating schemas and verifying extraction accuracy.

features.name: Granular governance for data graphs
features.says: Data graphs now support granular access control, automatically pruning restricted fields, masking data, and excluding unauthorized child DMOs based on governance policies instead of the previous all-or-nothing model.

features.name: Gamma and Quantile regression loss functions
features.says: Select the Gamma or Quantile regression loss function in Model Builder to analyze skewed data and predict specific percentiles rather than average values.

features.name: Unsupervised clustering
features.says: Cluster records dynamically with pre-trained algorithms, without training or maintaining a reusable model, to find natural groupings and anomalies and to produce cluster labels for downstream models.

features.name: Preconfigured predictive model templates
features.says: Model Builder can prepopulate model details, variables, filter conditions, and a recommended algorithm from a template for specific use cases, which you can review and customize before training.

features.name: Propensity to Buy template (Beta)
features.says: The Propensity to Buy template automatically combines standard DMO data to train a model that predicts purchase likelihood for a product or category within a period, for use in segmentation, campaigns, flows, and Agentforce actions.

features.name: Snowflake zero-copy V2 connector for data sharing
features.says: Share data with Snowflake through the zero-copy V2 connector, authenticating with OIDC instead of the legacy username and password OAuth, and query shared data as a mounted Snowflake database without duplication.

features.name: Use third-party identity provider attributes for Ad Audiences partner activations
features.says: Use Identity Boost from clean room collaborations in the activation flow for Ad Audiences partner targets, enriching records with identifiers such as email and phone to improve audience matching before activation.

features.name: Improve Ad Audiences match rates with Identity Boost
features.says: Enrich first-party customer data with attributes such as email addresses and phone numbers through a certified identity provider in a clean room, then activate the enriched data to Ad Audiences partners without manual appends or purchased third-party data.

features.name: Activate audiences to Reddit
features.says: Reddit is now a native activation destination in Data Cloud, so segments can be activated directly to Reddit for targeted advertising campaigns and insights reporting.

features.name: Run custom Python transformations on zero-copy data
features.says: Code extension can run custom Python batch transformations on a DLO backed by a zero-copy connector, or on a DMO mapped from it, accessing data on the external platform without copying it.

features.name: Quick Pages (beta)
features.says: Users describe the custom page they need in natural language and an agent builds a React-based UI grounded in Salesforce data, combining multiple objects and fields into one shareable view.

features.name: Verify email-sending domains for Trialforce templates and source orgs
features.says: Email-sending domains must be verified in the Trialforce management org to create new branded email set source orgs or templates, though existing DKIM or authorized domain setups are automatically verified.

features.name: GraphQL API updates
features.says: New and changed GraphQL API capabilities are introduced, detailed on a separate page.

features.name: Remove non-public fields from Custom Object data in Aura action responses (Release Update)
features.says: Non-public system fields are filtered out of custom object data returned in Aura action responses, so components must use only API-supported fields to avoid JavaScript errors or missing data; enforced in Spring '27.

features.name: Update instanced URLs in API traffic (Release Update)
features.says: API traffic must use the org's My Domain login URL instead of an incorrect instanced URL, as enforcement is phased from October 2026 in sandboxes and January 2027 in production.

features.name: AI tags for LWCs and Aura components no longer supported
features.says: Adding an <ai> tag to Lightning web component configuration files or <design:ai> to Aura design bundles now throws an error, though components with these tags from before Winter '27 keep working.

features.name: Validate-only deployment
features.says: Validate-only deployments find deployment errors, Apex test failures, and code coverage issues without modifying the target org, and a successful validation can be promoted within 10 days without rerunning Apex tests.

features.name: Allowlist external domains that can frame Visualforce pages
features.says: External domains can iframe Visualforce pages or surveys only when added to an allowlist in Session Settings with the iframe type set to Visualforce Pages.

features.name: Support Refresh Token Rotation in mobile publisher apps
features.says: Salesforce enables Refresh Token Rotation to defend against stolen-credential and token-replay attacks, so publisher apps should be updated to support it.

features.name: Additional metadata types in Metadata API
features.says: Access more metadata through new and changed metadata types.

features.name: Custom sharing reasons on standard objects
features.says: Programmatic shares on standard objects can reference a custom sharing reason (row cause) in Apex instead of only Manual, and such shares persist when record ownership changes.

features.name: Create native mobile apps with Agentforce (Generally Available)
features.says: Agentforce builds native mobile apps for employees or customers from natural language descriptions, with layout design, App Store and Google Play publishing, and usage analytics in one flow.

features.name: Support Refresh Token Rotation in branded apps
features.says: Salesforce enables Refresh Token Rotation to defend against stolen-credential and token-replay attacks, so branded apps should be updated to support it.

features.name: Per-user credentials for external MCP servers
features.says: Users can authenticate to external MCP servers through OAuth 2.0 browser flows with their own credentials, using an external credential that provides per-user authentication.

features.name: Create custom Salesforce-hosted MCP servers headlessly
features.says: Custom Salesforce-hosted MCP servers can be created through the API Catalog Connect REST API to expose tools and prompts to Agentforce and supported MCP clients.

features.name: New Digital Wallet home page and left-side navigation
features.says: The Digital Wallet app gets a central home page and a left-side navigation menu that groups related features, plus direct access to billing information such as invoices and contracts.

features.name: Export license utilization data from Digital Wallet
features.says: License utilization data can be exported to a CSV file for holistic review or analysis in an external BI tool.

features.name: Import Jira work items into Lifecycle Center
features.says: A connected Jira workspace lets users search, filter, and bulk-import work items into Lifecycle Center, keeping summaries and descriptions and maintaining a permanent reference to the original Jira items.

features.name: Updated label translations for standard objects, tabs, and fields
features.says: Translations for some standard object, tab, and field names are updated across 36 languages to improve accuracy.

features.name: Track Agentforce Vibes usage in Scratch Orgs
features.says: Agentforce Vibes consumption in scratch orgs can be monitored in Digital Wallet to track developer-driven costs.

features.name: Bulk delete CMS content and folders in enhanced workspaces
features.says: Folders and content, including published items, can be deleted in bulk, and deleting a folder removes everything within it; previously deletion was limited to one unpublished item or empty folders.

features.name: Next Generation DevOps Center renamed Lifecycle Center
features.says: Next Generation DevOps Center is now Lifecycle Center, combining governance, change and release management, and real-time analytics, with existing projects, pipelines, environments, and work items continuing to work.

features.name: Lifecycle Center Governance for coding agents (beta)
features.says: Predefined governance policies are managed in Lifecycle Center and applied to Agentforce Vibes coding agents, with rules mapping to enforcements such as Code Analyzer checks that can be enabled or disabled.

features.name: Org Health and Usage in Setup
features.says: Org Health and Usage is available in Setup for all admins without Salesforce with Agentforce, showing ranked metrics for security, performance, trust, usage, and more.

features.name: Dark mode for SLDS 2 themes (Generally Available)
features.says: Dark mode for SLDS 2 themes is generally available so users can switch to a darker appearance, and admins can upload a dark-mode version of the company logo.

features.name: New and changed standard objects in the API
features.says: Standard objects are new or changed, giving access to more data through the API.

features.name: Manage Dev Hub from coding client with AI Skill
features.says: The new dx-org-devhub-configure AI Skill lets you enable and manage your Dev Hub from your AI coding client using natural-language prompts.

features.name: Create and track trial orgs with AI Skills
features.says: Two AI Skills let you create trial, Developer Edition, and Trialforce orgs and track when your orgs expire, using natural-language prompts in your AI coding client.

features.name: Automate managed package post-install configuration with AI Skill
features.says: The dx-pkg-post-install-configure AI Skill automates post-install configuration for any Salesforce managed package from your AI coding client.

features.name: Manage full sandbox lifecycle with AI Skills
features.says: Three AI Skills help you create, refresh, and activate sandboxes and generate and apply post-copy configuration files.

features.name: Create, compare, and manage Scratch Orgs with AI Skills
features.says: Five AI Skills help you create and manage scratch orgs, org shapes, and scratch org snapshots, compare orgs for drift, and track org expiration.

features.name: Changed System namespace classes, enums, and interfaces
features.says: Classes, enums, and interfaces in the System namespace are new or have changed.

features.name: Validate Field Generation Refinements setting
features.says: A new Setup setting, Validate Field Generation Refinements, limits follow-up field generation requests to business-relevant activity so Einstein credits are spent only on relevant use cases.

features.name: Field generation refinements use selected model
features.says: Follow-up and refinement responses in the field generation panel now use the model selected in the prompt template instead of the Salesforce default LLM.

features.name: Page-based Quick Actions (Beta)
features.says: Quick actions can be built from reusable action layouts authored in Lightning App Builder and shared across multiple quick actions, so updates to the page apply to all of them.

features.name: Slackbot usage visibility in Digital Wallet
features.says: Flex Credits Slackbot consumption can be tracked and monitored in Digital Wallet after opting in; Slackbot usage draws on Flex Credits once the plan's message allowance is exhausted, supported only for production org connections.

features.name: Apex cursors for Data 360 DMOs (Beta)
features.says: Apex cursors can process large SOQL result sets from Data 360 data model objects in chunks using Database.getCursor(), Cursor.fetch(), and Cursor.getNumRecords(), with monitoring of cursor rows, instances, and Flex Credit limits.

features.name: Experience Builder Agent (Beta) discontinued
features.says: The Experience Builder Agent beta for enhanced LWR sites is discontinued as of Winter '27, so existing agents can no longer be used and it can no longer be enabled.

features.name: Increased Apex heap limits
features.says: The Apex heap limit rises from 6 MB to 10 MB for synchronous transactions and from 12 MB to 25 MB for asynchronous transactions.

features.name: Recompile only invalid Apex classes and triggers
features.says: Compilation results for Apex classes and triggers with validation errors are returned through Setup or the Tooling API, and only classes and triggers needing recompilation are identified, reducing compilation overhead.

features.name: LWC skills in Agentforce Vibes
features.says: Agentforce Vibes includes skills covering the full LWC lifecycle, including accessibility, data, design, testing, security, and quality review, applied automatically when a task matches.

features.name: New and changed Lightning Web Components
features.says: New and changed Lightning Web Components are available for building UI.

features.name: Retirement of Platform API versions 31.0 through 40.0
features.says: Salesforce Platform API versions 31.0 through 40.0 are being deprecated and retired, so integrations on those versions must be migrated.

features.name: New and changed Tooling API objects
features.says: Tooling API objects are new or changed, providing access to more metadata.

features.name: MCP server tools in Agentforce Builder
features.says: AgentExchange-hosted MCP server tools can be added to Agentforce agents from the enhanced actions modal, which has an Asset Type filter to switch between actions and MCP server tools.

features.name: Install AgentExchange apps inside Agentforce Builder
features.says: One or several AgentExchange apps can be installed from Agentforce Builder, with a background progress strip and notifications when installs finish and components are ready.

features.name: Persistent AgentExchange navigation menu with mega-menus
features.says: A persistent header on every page replaces the flat link list with mega-menus for Business Needs, Products, Solution Types, Consultants, and Learn, including curated collections and one-line descriptions.

features.name: Org-tailored AgentExchange homepage recommendations
features.says: When logged in with a selected org, the homepage highlights listings matching the org's edition, products, and industry, and users can pick and switch orgs from a searchable list and the header org badge.

features.name: Slack and Tableau Next apps in AgentExchange search
features.says: Slack and Tableau Next apps appear alongside Salesforce solutions in search, Slack apps carry a Slack badge, can be filtered on their own, and open their Slack Marketplace listing in a new tab.

features.name: Sell external SaaS and services via private offers in GTM app
features.says: Partners can sell external SaaS and professional services, including implementation and training, alongside Salesforce apps through private offers in the GTM app, with one consolidated invoice instead of separate billing.

features.name: Customer contract renewals in the GTM app
features.says: Partners can create, send, and fulfill renewal offers for existing contracts in the GTM app, pre-populated with current entitlements and editable products, quantities, pricing, and terms, with billing and provisioning running automatically on the anniversary date.

features.name: Multi-year contract terms for private offers
features.says: Private offers can use 24-month or 36-month terms in addition to 12-month, billed annually, with the full contract length shown before acceptance.

features.name: Add functionality via Permission Set Licenses to Partner Provisionable products
features.says: Partners can replace a Partner Provisionable Product with a version that adds functionality through Permission Set Licenses, giving existing customers the added PSLs at no extra charge while keeping entitlements, with affected-customer counts shown before confirmation.

features.name: UI bundle client-side security checks in AgentExchange Security Review
features.says: Security Review now checks UI bundles for client-side risks such as cross-site scripting and untrusted scripts, and partners should learn the framework, scan, and coding rules before submitting.

features.name: Elastic limits for Batch Apex jobs (Beta)
features.says: Elastic limits now cover Batch jobs as well as future and Queueable jobs, allowing enqueuing up to a higher limit above the rolling 24-hour asynchronous job cap, with in-flight Batch jobs throttled and new ones limited to one active job when exceeded.

features.name: Override asynchronous job limit to test elastic limits
features.says: In nonproduction orgs, the 24-hour asynchronous Apex job limit can be overridden so elastic processing triggers sooner, letting teams test async behavior before enabling elastic limits in production.

features.name: Apex integration tests calling real HTTP endpoints (Developer Preview)
features.says: Integration tests can call real HTTP and external service endpoints without mock callouts, with relaxed callout and rollback rules, and a new @BeforeClass annotation sets up shared test data.

features.name: testLevel parameter in test discovery API
features.says: The testLevel query parameter filters returned test methods by test level and replaces showAllMethods from API version 68.0, which remains only in version 67.0 and earlier.

features.name: explicitNamespace for managed package SOQL field conflicts
features.says: Setting explicitNamespace on Database.QueryOptions and passing it through the SOQL SET OPTIONS clause prevents duplicate field name errors when package and subscriber custom fields share a name.

features.name: Block anonymous Apex from managed package session IDs (Release Update)
features.says: Enabling this update stops installed managed packages from getting a session ID via UserInfo.getSessionId() and using it to run anonymous Apex.

features.name: Apex symbol API (beta)
features.says: A Tooling API REST resource returns detailed metadata for built-in, custom, and dynamic Apex types, usable for IDE code completion, AI agent context, and answering admin code questions.

features.name: Compiler warnings for Apex API versions 9.0 to 19.0
features.says: Classes and triggers at API versions 9.0 through 19.0 will be retired, and the compiler now warns on compile or deploy, so they should be updated to version 20.0 or later.

features.name: Composite API event types in EventLogFile
features.says: Querying EventLogFile for the CompositeApi and CompositeApiSubrequest event types returns details on composite and composite graph API requests and subrequests.

features.name: Self-serve Salesforce edge network routing setup
features.says: Network routing can be managed on the My Domain Setup page without contacting Salesforce Customer Support each time.

features.name: Per-channel replay watermark in Streaming API
features.says: From API version 68.0, every successful /meta/connect response includes a per-channel replay watermark in ext.replay that clients can use to update replay IDs on resubscription, so older events need not be reprocessed.

features.name: Use Any API Auth permission required for SOAP login() (Release Update)
features.says: All users must have the Use Any API Auth permission to authenticate with SOAP API login(), enforced uniformly from December 1, 2026, and testable now via the Release Update in Setup.

features.name: latest keyword in REST API version URIs
features.says: A REST API URI can use latest in place of a numbered version, routing requests to the most recent version the org supports, as listed by the List Available REST API Versions resource.

features.name: Bulk API 2.0 marketing object data ingestion and refresh operation
features.says: Marketing objects support insert and upsert operations, plus a new refresh operation for marketing objects only that replaces all data in the target data set.

features.name: Retirement of SOAP API login() call in versions 31.0-64.0 (Release Update)
features.says: In Summer '27, the SOAP API login() call in SOAP API versions 31.0 through 64.0 will no longer be supported and no longer be available.

features.name: Arithmetic comparisons between fields in SOQL WHERE clause (beta)
features.says: The FORMULA() function lets you perform arithmetic calculations directly in a SOQL WHERE clause to compare field values without adding a formula field or post-processing logic.

features.name: Stable target host name for third-party custom domains on Edge Network
features.says: Update the target host name for a third-party-served custom domain to your org's My Domain login URL, which keeps working when your Salesforce instance or Hyperforce cell changes, reducing maintenance downtime risk.

features.name: Discontinuation of Experience Delivery and Experience Cloud Agent beta features
features.says: The Experience Delivery and Experience Cloud Agent beta features are discontinued.

features.name: Experience Cloud site sender address for unverified email domains
features.says: Specify the From address each Experience Cloud site uses to send email on behalf of a user with an unverified email domain.

features.name: Hide sensitive fields from guest users in Experience Cloud
features.says: Identify and hide fields containing sensitive information from guest users while keeping them visible to portal users.

features.name: External services based on OpenAPI schema supporting any shape
features.says: An external service can be created from an OpenAPI schema using schema: {}, so Flow external service actions need no Apex class or Transform element and data is sent directly to the endpoint, with flows continuing to work if the data schema changes.

features.name: Multiple flow approval processes in Request Approvals component
features.says: Configure the Request Approvals component in Experience Builder to give submitters up to 10 autolaunched flow approval processes to choose from for a record.

features.name: Automatically open next work item in Orchestration Work Guide
features.says: Configure the Orchestration Work Guide component to automatically open the next work item from the same orchestration run when a user completes one.

features.name: Flexible inline editing in List Views
features.says: Two User Interface Settings let users inline edit any field they can edit, regardless of page layout, and allow inline editing in list views containing multiple record types.

features.name: Field history tracking for User object (Generally Available)
features.says: Track up to 20 fields on the User object, viewing a log of changes with old and new values, timestamps, and who made each update, and report on user activity.

features.name: View Setup Audit Trail permission (release update)
features.says: A dedicated View Setup Audit Trail permission controls access to Setup Audit Trail without granting the broader View Setup permission; existing access is preserved automatically.

features.name: ICU locale formats replace JDK locale formats (Release Update)
features.says: ICU locale formats replace Oracle's JDK locale formats for dates, times, currencies, addresses, names, numbers, and week start days, and orgs not yet switched are encouraged to update manually.

features.name: LWC API version 68.0 for latest Lightning Web Component changes
features.says: Updating component API versions to 68.0 gives access to new LWC features and improvements while versioning protects existing components from changes in behavior.

features.name: Programmatic anchor clicks for same-origin URLs under LWS
features.says: With Lightning Web Security enabled, window.open() on same-origin Salesforce URLs throws a LockerSecurityError, so replace these calls with a detached programmatic anchor click.

features.name: Navigation item management API for Lightning console apps
features.says: The lightning/platformNavigationItemApi module provides methods to manage navigation items in the item menu of a Lightning console app.

features.name: Third-party web components in LWC (Generally Available)
features.says: Integrate third-party web components into LWC apps without rewriting them by rendering them as native web components with lwc:external.

features.name: Refresh action for built-in state managers
features.says: The refresh() action fetches the latest server data for state managers exposing list or query data, such as related list records, without reconfiguring or reloading the page.

features.name: Salesforce microfrontend (UI embedding)
features.says: Embed existing web apps directly in a Salesforce page and exchange data, styling, and events with them over a secure channel.

features.name: Mobile app AI-suggested next steps and post-meeting voice notes
features.says: The Salesforce mobile app adds AI-generated suggested next steps for meeting follow-up, hybrid cloud and on-device audio processing for capturing meetings, and Post-Meeting Voice Notes.

features.name: Agentforce DX pro-code agent development (Headless 360)
features.says: Create, preview, and test agents directly in a Salesforce DX project using pro-code tools such as Salesforce CLI and VS Code.

features.name: Developer Console hidden in Setup by default
features.says: In Winter '27 the Developer Console option is not visible by default in Setup.

features.name: Salesforce DX MCP Server
features.says: The DX MCP Server lets developers enter natural language prompts in their IDE to run standard DX tasks such as syncing metadata, running Apex and agent tests, and creating scratch orgs.

features.name: Salesforce extensions for visual studio Code
features.says: The Salesforce Extension pack provides tools in VS Code for working with scratch orgs, sandboxes, DE orgs, Apex, Lightning web components, Aura components, and Visualforce.

features.name: Web Console
features.says: Web Console is a lightweight, browser-based IDE built into Salesforce, powered by VS Code for Web, that replaces legacy tools without local installation or complex setup.

features.name: Agentforce conversation client (ACC)
features.says: ACC provides front-end infrastructure that turns raw AI data into an interactive user experience for employee agents in Salesforce Lightning and external web applications.

features.name: Edit metadata through the Metadata Visualizer
features.says: Users can select elements on the Metadata Visualizer canvas, describe a change, and Agentforce Vibes updates the metadata and its dependencies for data models, agent scripts, flows, and permission sets.

features.name: Unified Employee license restrictions on Custom Objects
features.says: Unified Employee licensed users can't access custom objects unless they are part of a security-reviewed AppExchange managed package, so profiles, permission sets, or groups with restricted custom objects can't be assigned to them or have such objects added.

features.name: Defer sharing calculations for bulk Unified Employee updates
features.says: Defer sharing calculations before bulk Unified Employee user creation or before updating sharing rules that affect the All Restricted Employee User group to avoid performance issues or failures.

features.name: User Profile button for designating employee users
features.says: The User Profile button on the User details page opens the Chatter profile page to designate employee users, for network-only users with the Unified Employee license or users with the Salesforce Platform license when Chatter is off.

features.name: Retain manual shares when transferring records
features.says: An org-level setting on the Sharing Settings page lets admins choose whether manual shares are kept when a record changes owner; it is disabled by default, preserving the prior behavior of deleting them.

features.name: Profile Filtering enabled by default (Release Update)
features.says: Profile Filtering is enabled by default, preventing users from viewing profile names other than their own unless they have the View All Profiles permission, which must be assigned before enforcement in Winter '27.

features.name: Update Apex and flows for asynchronous sharing recalculation (Release Update)
features.says: Some sharing recalculations after large group or role updates now run asynchronously, so Apex classes, tests, triggers, and flows that need immediate share record updates must be updated before this release update is enforced.

features.name: Brand content type in enhanced CMS workspaces
features.says: The Brand content type is now available in all enhanced CMS workspaces, allowing brands to be created with customized colors, typography, buttons, and borders for React apps, previously limited to Marketing Cloud Next marketing workspaces.

features.name: Semantic search with CMS Base data kit 2.0
features.says: Deploying version 2.0 of the CMS Base data kit adds a content taxonomy transform and a taxonomy-based search index so AI-powered search can find tagged content whose tags match the semantic meaning of a keyword, not only exact matches.

features.name: Retirement of cross-org adapter password and OAuth authentication (Release Update)
features.says: Password and OAuth 2.0 authentication for the Salesforce Connect cross-org adapter, which rely on the retiring SOAP login() call, are being retired, so external data sources should migrate to named credentials.

features.name: Salesforce Functions retirement
features.says: Salesforce Functions is no longer available for purchase or renewal; subscriptions continue through the existing order term, and an alternative solution should be deployed before that term ends.

features.name: SLDS AI skills in Agentforce Vibes
features.says: Three AI skills in Agentforce Vibes help apply and validate SLDS 2 design code, catch compliance issues, and migrate SLDS 1 code to SLDS 2.

features.name: Data Mask & Seed for sandboxes
features.says: Admins and dev teams can define masking policies with Data Mask & Seed to mask sensitive sandbox data, including proprietary, restricted, regulated, and personally identifiable information.

features.product: New and Changed Items for Developers
features.name: Lightning Components new and changed items
features.says: New and changed resources are available for building UI with Lightning components.

features.product: New and Changed Items for Developers
features.name: ConnectApi new and changed classes and enums
features.says: New and changed ConnectApi classes and enums are available for building custom experiences with Connect in Apex.
