features.product: New and Changed Items for Developers
features.name: API version 68.0 new data objects and metadata types
features.says: API version 68.0 provides access to more data objects and metadata types.

features.name: Pay per Lead Worked pricing model for Engagement agents
features.says: Engagement agents can be billed a flat number of flex credits for each lead or prospect worked within 30 days, as an alternative to paying per individual agent action plus data usage.

features.name: Momentum
features.says: Momentum automatically captures upcoming meetings, emails, and recorded customer conversations and structures them in Salesforce, unlocking features such as Executive Briefs and Call Coaching.

features.name: Authorized email domain verification settings
features.says: Admins can specify, per authorized email domain, whether email address verification is required only when users change their address or is disabled entirely, instead of contacting Customer Support.

features.name: Create and update Salesforce records in Claude (Beta)
features.says: Salesforce in Claude can now create and update Salesforce records directly, enforcing the same field-level validation rules as Lightning Experience, rather than being read-only or only creating drafts.

features.name: Multi-factor authentication in the Spiff mobile app
features.says: The Spiff mobile app now supports MFA, requiring users to enter an authenticator app code after their password before Spiff opens.

features.name: Salesforce to Salesforce retirement
features.says: Salesforce to Salesforce is being retired in Spring '27, and integrations should migrate to Partner Cloud, Data Cloud One, MuleSoft Anypoint, or MuleSoft for Flow.

features.name: Unified sales and marketing email engagement data in Data 360
features.says: Sales email engagement data can be brought into Data 360 alongside marketing email engagement data to give a complete view of email interactions.

features.name: Email verification exception maintenance (Release Update)
features.says: Customers who previously disabled user email verification through Customer Support must configure an authorized email domain setting to keep the exception, as existing domain allowlists are removed when enforced on December 1, 2026.

features.name: Forecasting Agent
features.says: Forecasting Agent analyzes pipeline changes, flags deals needing attention to hit quota, and helps complete forecast submissions using opportunity scores and deal insights.

features.name: Salesforce for Outlook retirement
features.says: Salesforce for Outlook is being retired in January 2027, with the Outlook integration and Einstein Activity Capture recommended as replacements.

features.name: Salesforce context in Claude (Beta)
features.says: Deal health, pipeline risk, and account context from live Salesforce data can be surfaced in Claude conversations through a secure Salesforce MCP connection and pre-built skills, read-only at beta launch.

features.name: Guided automated account field updates in Salesforce Go
features.says: A new guided setup in Salesforce Go lets admins configure automated field updates within Account Management by adding fields, choosing update methods, entering instructions, and activating or deactivating each configuration.

features.name: Streamlined Pipeline Management field update setup in Salesforce Go
features.says: New Pipeline Management users get an Automate Field Updates guided workflow in Salesforce Go that automates steps previously configured manually for opportunity field updates.

features.name: Guided account Plans setup in Salesforce Go
features.says: Account Plans setup in Salesforce Go is a full guided experience from one location, and a single permission set can grant required object and field access instead of configuring each object separately.

features.name: Keyword and wildcard exclusions for Einstein Activity Capture
features.says: Admins can exclude emails containing specific keywords or phrases and use wildcard rules to exclude calendar events and emails for web domains; sensitive data detection also excludes 'confidential'-prefixed Outlook and Gmail subjects and Outlook messages marked confidential or private.

features.name: Pipeline Management configuration skill
features.says: A natural-language configuration skill for Agentforce Pipeline Management handles required setup steps for configuring text fields on opportunities, with reps able to approve suggestions or admins enabling autonomous mode.

features.name: Location templates for WhatsApp messaging
features.says: Location headers can be added to WhatsApp utility and marketing templates so customers receive a clickable map view of a specified location, sent by agents on UCP and Enhanced WhatsApp channels.

features.name: More natural WhatsApp voice messages from AI agent
features.says: WhatsApp voice messages from the AI agent use a more natural accent and better pronunciation, and read account, contract, and ID numbers digit by digit.

features.name: Shared WhatsApp numbers across providers (WAME)
features.says: Meta's WhatsApp Account Model Evolution lets one WhatsApp number serve multiple BSPs, each with its own template library and billing, with existing accounts migrated automatically and no reconfiguration or extra license.

features.name: RCS as a service messaging channel
features.says: Service teams get a native RCS channel where customers can start conversations routed to a human agent in the Service Console or an Agentforce agent, whereas RCS previously was limited to outbound and Marketing Cloud use cases.

features.name: Delete conversation data from Flow or Apex
features.says: Conversation Data API delete operations can be called from Flow or Apex, with Salesforce handling authentication, to remove messaging end users and their data or delete specific conversations, up to 50 records per call.

features.name: Proactive Service Replies for transferred chats
features.says: When a service rep accepts a handoff from Agentforce or another rep, two grounded replies and one contextual reply appear before the customer sends another message, drawn from the transcript and knowledge articles.

features.name: Multi-intent Service Replies
features.says: When a customer message contains multiple questions, Service Replies detects each intention and shows a separate grounded reply for each, rather than blending intents or answering only the most pertinent one.

features.name: Multi-intent article recommendations for Cases
features.says: Agentforce Article Recommendations for Cases identifies up to three distinct intents in a case, runs a targeted search for each, and merges results into one ranked list of articles.

features.name: Sentiment in command center for service V2
features.says: Customer Signals Intelligence sentiment appears as the User Sentiment column in the In-Progress Work component, showing Positive, Neutral, or Negative indicators for active work items.

features.name: Real-time sentiment insights for voice calls
features.says: Customer Signals Intelligence now provides real-time sentiment on voice calls, letting reps see sentiment shift during a conversation and supervisors use cross-call trend data.

features.name: Clone a Knowledge article
features.says: A new Knowledge article can be started from an existing one, copying its fields and attached files so teams can tailor a proven structure instead of recreating it.

features.name: Private Knowledge article images after archive or restriction
features.says: Salesforce checks the status and public visibility of a Knowledge article version before serving its embedded images, so archived or internal-only article images are no longer reachable at direct URLs by guest users.

features.name: WhatsApp voice messages for Agentforce
features.says: WhatsApp users can send voice messages to an Agentforce agent, switch between voice and text in one conversation, and receive replies in the same format they used.

features.name: Update conversation entries via Conversation Data API
features.says: The Conversation Data API can update existing conversation entries, correcting message text, updating payloads of non-text entries such as attachments, and associating or updating related records, without deleting and recreating them.

features.name: WhatsApp Service and Utility message pricing changes
features.says: Meta charges per message for Service messages and utility messages sent within the Customer Service Window, which were previously free, and Salesforce will update pricing effective November 1, 2026.

features.name: Enhanced Chat v2 default for new orgs
features.says: New orgs that enable chat start on Enhanced Chat v2 instead of v1 with no extra configuration; existing orgs keep their current setup.

features.name: Agentforce Contact Center
features.says: Agentforce Contact Center is an AI-first contact center within Salesforce with built-in telephony and Workforce Engagement Management.

features.name: Partner Contact Center
features.says: Third-party contact centers such as Amazon Connect can be connected to Salesforce through Partner Contact Center, formerly Salesforce Voice with Telephony Providers and Service Cloud Voice, with voice enhancements for inbound and outbound engagement.

features.name: Messaging enhancements for contact center
features.says: Enhancements help reps and supervisors resolve customer issues more efficiently over Messaging channels.

features.name: Email in the Service Console
features.says: Customer email conversations can be managed directly in the Service Console, and incoming email can be turned into cases with Email-to-Case.

features.name: IT service desk optimization
features.says: Service desk operations are optimized to prioritize high-value users, resolve incidents faster through email and comments, manage service request lifecycles, and provide console insights.

features.name: Role-based configuration item List Views
features.says: Configuration item list views can display role-relevant details, with standard or custom reference fields and direct opening of related records from the list.

features.name: Dynamic Discovery with Splunk
features.says: CMDB data is kept current with server and cloud inventory and operational events from Splunk, with Dynamic Discovery creating discovery targets and new Discovery objects and a platform event.

features.name: AI file analysis for IT tickets
features.says: File analysis for IT tickets is automated, and AI prompts and field mappings can be customized to match organizational processes.

features.name: Slackbot and Teams collaboration channels
features.says: Slackbot resolves IT requests such as password resets and account provisioning through conversation, one-click Teams integration is available, and Teams list views can be customized.

features.name: Employee Services portal self-service controls
features.says: Admins control fields and buttons on portal ticket and approval pages without code, offer the portal in preferred languages, and add comments and a feed to tickets; Agentforce turns resolved tickets into Knowledge articles.

features.name: Broadcast communications and notifications
features.says: Broadcast updates can go out through email, in-app, Slack, and Teams in one action, Slack alerts can become structured notifications with action buttons, and Agentforce agents can deliver notifications with follow-up in the Slack thread.

features.name: Prebuilt Agentforce agents for HR service
features.says: Prebuilt Agentforce agents cover high-frequency employee requests for payroll, compensation, time and scheduling, onboarding, and goals management.

features.name: Enhanced Summaries in five additional languages
features.says: Enhanced Summaries for Case now support five additional languages, so more global service reps receive summaries in their preferred language.

features.name: Work Summaries for Voice and Enhanced Messaging
features.says: Work Summaries are automatically generated and saved for Voice calls and Enhanced Messaging sessions, and now support five additional languages.

features.name: Work Summaries for Case retirement (beta)
features.says: Work Summaries for Case (beta) is scheduled for retirement on September 30, 2026.

features.name: Service Replies multi-intent detection
features.says: Service Replies detects up to two intents in one customer message and shows a separate grounded reply for each intent that finds a knowledge article.

features.name: Service Replies for Email grounded in Enterprise Knowledge
features.says: Service Replies for Email can now ground suggested replies in Enterprise Knowledge sources.

features.name: AI writing tools in case comment editor
features.says: Service reps can use AI writing tools in the case comment editor to polish, expand, or summarize drafts, and refine comments using instructions based on the admin-configured Refine Case Comment prompt template.

features.name: Inline display of original case attachments
features.says: Original case attachments display inline under the Case Description field, showing up to three attachment tiles with a popover link to view additional files, for cases created through all channels.

features.name: Consolidated case merge setup page
features.says: Case merge settings for Case Merge, Enhanced Case Merge (Beta), and Case Merge for Omni-Channel (Beta) are configured from one setup page, which gives access to Duplicate Rules and Matching Rules.

features.name: Experience Signals at no additional cost in CSI
features.says: Customer Signals Intelligence offers Experience Signals at no additional cost, so only Data Cloud credits and Flex Credits for LLM requests and agent actions are consumed.

features.name: Bulk deletion of case milestones
features.says: Case milestones can be deleted in bulk through Data Loader or programmatically via Apex to reclaim storage used by outdated milestone records, which previously could not be deleted.

features.name: Five new HR Service workflow templates
features.says: Five templates added to the HR Service workflow library, such as shift swaps, timecard corrections, and direct deposit updates, route requests and track them through resolution without custom case logic.

features.name: Case visibility policies for confidential cases
features.says: Visibility rules defined on the case object with the Policy Engine limit access to confidential cases to the logger, queue members, case team users, and HR Case Investigator permission holders, removing the need for the public complaint case junction entity.

features.name: Knowledge Blocks for reusable content
features.says: Knowledge Blocks are reusable, read-only content units inserted into any article, and publishing a new block version updates every article that uses it.

features.name: Knowledge article creation from any record with custom Prompt Templates
features.says: Reps can draft Knowledge articles from any record using multiple custom Prompt Builder templates, created from the single out-of-the-box template previously limited to cases and messaging sessions.

features.name: Knowledge Similarity duplicate detection
features.says: Authors checking a draft article see similar existing articles with a similarity score, so they can reuse or update an article instead of creating a duplicate.

features.name: Guided Omni-Channel setup skill
features.says: The service-omni-channel-setup-coordinate skill guides configuration of routing, queues, users, presence statuses, permissions, and supervisor access, reusing existing configuration and creating what is missing.

features.name: Service Reps component in Command Center
features.says: The Service Reps component in Command Center for Service V2 shows real-time rep status, presence, capacity, workload, and active work in one list view.

features.name: Backlog component in Command Center
features.says: The Backlog Lightning App Builder component in Command Center for Service V2 shows skills-based, queue-based, and direct-to-agent work waiting to be routed, with wait times.

features.name: Faster conversation routing to bots
features.says: Conversations routed to bots skip pending service routing and move directly to an opened state, and bots join without waiting for synchronous confirmation.

features.name: Automatic Enhanced Chat deployment in Agentic Portal setup
features.says: Agentic Portal setup provisions and deploys Enhanced Chat automatically, so the Customer Service Portal or Help agent is accessible on the site when setup finishes.

features.name: In-app notifications for proactive service
features.says: Proactive service outreach can be delivered as mobile in-app notifications in addition to email, for apps built with Salesforce Mobile Publisher.

features.name: Reusable troubleshooting action for proactive scenarios
features.says: A general-purpose troubleshooting action grounds responses in Knowledge articles and case history and walks customers through interactive resolution steps, without a separate topic and action per scenario.

features.name: Agentic Portal guided setup wizard
features.says: A setup wizard takes admins from Salesforce Go through site creation, feature configuration, component setup, review, and one-click deployment, with a live preview and progressive record creation.

features.name: Help Agent guided setup skill
features.says: The service-helpagent-coordinate skill runs agent configuration, knowledge grounding, Enhanced Chat deployment, escalation routing, and testing in one guided workflow.

features.name: Help Agent deployment to more channels
features.says: Help Agents can be deployed through a new Agentic Portal, to Experience Cloud sites requiring customer login, and to Voice via an existing native Voice channel or a new Salesforce-managed number for US and Canada.

features.name: SLA Performance dashboard in service insights
features.says: A pre-built SLA Performance dashboard shows SLA compliance rates, milestone breach trends, and breach patterns by case type and severity.

features.name: Slackbot in Salesforce: search, summarize and act across systems
features.says: Slackbot is now built into Salesforce, not just Slack, and uses the same context and access to information as the user to search, summarize and plan next steps across both systems from anywhere in Salesforce.

features.product: Sell Smarter in Slack: Agentforce Sales and the New Go Page
features.name: Agentforce Sales available in Slackbot
features.says: Agentforce Sales is now available directly in Slackbot, bringing Sales agents into the Slack workflow.

features.product: Sell Smarter in Slack: Agentforce Sales and the New Go Page
features.name: New Go page for Agentforce Sales setup
features.says: A new dedicated Go page makes setup of Agentforce Sales fast and easy for admins.

enforced.name: Assign Use Any API Auth permission for SOAP login()
enforced.says: To authenticate with the SOAP API login() operation, all users must have the Use Any API Auth user permission assigned to them. Users without the Use Any API Auth user permission can no longer authenticate with SOAP API login() and will encounter an error.
enforced.when: Enforced with This Release
enforced.action: Assign the Use Any API Auth permission to every user who calls SOAP API login(), since users without it will get an error.

enforced.name: Enable accessibility enhancements for cards, docked containers, menu lists, and panels
enforced.says: To help meet Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 for Resize and Reflow, enable Lightning Experience to adapt the behavior of cards, docked containers, menu lists, and panels when viewed at high magnification. This release update is dependent on the Enable Accessibility Enhancements for Page Headers and Modal Windows When Zoom Is Greater Than 200% release update.
enforced.when: Enforced with This Release
enforced.action: Test cards, docked containers, menu lists, and panels at high magnification (above 200% zoom) in Lightning Experience to confirm they behave correctly.

enforced.name: Enable accessibility enhancements for date pickers, popovers, bottom utility bars, record headers
enforced.says: To help meet Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 for Resize and Reflow, enable Lightning Experience to adapt the behavior of date pickers, popovers, bottom utility bars, and record headers when viewed at high magnification. This release update is dependent on the Enable Accessibility Enhancements for Page Headers and Modal Windows When Zoom Is Greater Than 200% release update.
enforced.when: Enforced with This Release
enforced.action: Test date pickers, popovers, bottom utility bars, and record headers at high magnification (above 200% zoom) in Lightning Experience.

enforced.name: Enable accessibility enhancements for page headers and modal windows when zoom is greater than 200%
enforced.says: To help meet Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 for Resize and Reflow, enable Lightning Experience to adapt the behavior of page headers and modal windows when viewed at high magnification. This is the beginning of our effort to comply with WCAG 2.2 Resize and Reflow guidelines.
enforced.when: Enforced with This Release
enforced.action: Test page headers and modal windows at zoom levels above 200% in Lightning Experience, since this is the first step toward WCAG 2.2 compliance.

enforced.name: Enable Profile Filtering
enforced.says: To improve the security of your Salesforce org, the Profile Filtering setting is enabled by default. Profile filtering prevents users from viewing profile names other than their own unless they’re assigned the View All Profiles permission.
enforced.when: Enforced with This Release
enforced.action: Confirm which users need the View All Profiles permission, since profile names will otherwise be visible only to each user's own profile.

enforced.name: Maintain your email verification exception
enforced.says: If you previously disabled user email verifications through Salesforce Customer Support, configure an authorized email domain setting to maintain your exception and to preserve your users' ability to send email. When this release update is enforced, Salesforce removes the existing domain allowlists that disable email verification.
enforced.when: Scheduled To Be Enforced Before Spring ’27
enforced.action: Configure an authorized email domain setting before Spring '27 to keep your email verification exception and preserve users' ability to send email.

enforced.name: Restrict the OAuth 2.0 device flow to local External Client Apps
enforced.says: To secure the OAuth 2.0 device flow, Salesforce is restricting this flow to local external client apps with a localhost callback URL. To prepare for this change, review your usage of the device flow and update your connected apps and external client apps to meet the new criteria.
enforced.when: Scheduled To Be Enforced Before Spring ’27
enforced.action: Review any use of the OAuth 2.0 device flow and update Connected Apps and External Client Apps to use a localhost callback URL before Spring '27.

enforced.name: Conceal personal information fields from Guest users
enforced.says: Set field visibility for guest users without affecting your settings for other external users. Turn on Independent Guest Field Masking to hide certain fields specifically from guest users.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Turn on Independent Guest Field Masking and set field visibility so personal information is hidden from guest users without changing other external users' settings.

enforced.name: Enable accessibility enhancements for To Do lists and Lightning dual listboxes when zoom is greater than 200%
enforced.says: To help meet Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 for Resize and Reflow, enable Lightning Experience to adapt the behavior of To Do lists and Lightning dual listboxes when viewed at high magnification. This is part of our effort to comply with WCAG 2.2 Resize and Reflow guidelines.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Test To Do lists and Lightning dual listboxes at zoom levels above 200% in Lightning Experience before Spring '27 enforcement.

enforced.name: OAuth user-agent and hybrid user-agent flows retirement
enforced.says: Salesforce is retiring the OAuth user-agent flow and the OAuth hybrid user-agent flow. For better security, update your integrations to use the OAuth web-server flow or hybrid web-server flow with the Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) extension.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Update integrations that use the OAuth user-agent or hybrid user-agent flows to use the web-server or hybrid web-server flow with PKCE before Spring '27.

enforced.name: Remove non-public fields from Custom Object data in Aura action responses
enforced.says: To improve security, Salesforce is removing non-public system fields from custom object data returned in Aura action responses. This update filters out internal system fields that aren’t part of the public Salesforce API.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Check Aura components that rely on non-public system fields in Custom Object data, since those fields will be removed from action responses in Spring '27.

enforced.name: Render Visualforce Pages as Accessible (Tagged) PDFs (Beta)
enforced.says: With this update enabled, Visualforce pages rendered with renderAs="pdf" use the accessible PDF rendering engine, which produces tagged PDF/UA output. Tagged PDFs include the document structure and metadata that assistive technologies such as screen readers rely on.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Evaluate Visualforce pages that use renderAs="pdf" in the beta accessible PDF rendering engine to produce tagged PDF/UA output before Spring '27.

enforced.name: Retirement of OAuth 2.0 username-password flow for Connected Apps
enforced.says: When this release update is enforced, we'll stop supporting the OAuth 2.0 username-password flow for connected apps. This update will break all connected app integrations that use this flow.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Move Connected App integrations off the OAuth 2.0 username-password flow before Spring '27, since those integrations will break when it is retired.

enforced.name: Roll back Platform Event trigger transactions on unhandled exceptions
enforced.says: This update rolls back the transaction of a platform event Apex trigger when it throws an unhandled exception, so that partially written records are no longer committed.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Review Platform Event Apex triggers for unhandled exceptions, since their transactions will roll back instead of committing partial records in Spring '27.

enforced.name: Salesforce Connect cross-org adapter legacy authentication is being retired
enforced.says: The password and OAuth 2.0 authentication methods for the Salesforce Connect cross-org adapter are being retired. These authentication methods rely on the SOAP login() call, which is being retired.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Plan to move Salesforce Connect cross-org adapter connections off password and OAuth 2.0 authentication before Spring '27.

enforced.name: Salesforce to Salesforce is being retired
enforced.says: Salesforce to Salesforce is being retired in Spring ’27. Salesforce has more powerful and integrated solutions that align with modern business needs.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Plan a migration away from Salesforce to Salesforce before Spring '27, since the feature is being retired.

enforced.name: SOAP API login() call in SOAP API versions 31.0 through 64.0 is being retired
enforced.says: In Summer ‘27, the SOAP API login() call in SOAP API versions 31.0 through 64.0 will no longer be supported and no longer be available.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Replace SOAP API login() calls in API versions 31.0 through 64.0 with supported authentication before Summer '27, when the call is no longer available.

enforced.name: Update Apex code and flows for changed sharing recalculation behavior
enforced.says: To optimize performance after large-scale updates to groups or roles, Salesforce now performs some sharing recalculations asynchronously. If Apex code and flows require that share records be updated immediately, the code and flows can break when this release update is enforced.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Review Apex code and flows that need share records updated immediately after group or role changes, and make them handle asynchronous sharing recalculation.

enforced.name: Update instanced URLs in API traffic
enforced.says: To prevent disruption when Salesforce ends support for API traffic that uses an incorrect instanced URL, make sure that API traffic to your org uses the org’s My Domain login URL. First available in Summer ’25, this release update was scheduled to be enforced in Spring ’26, but we postponed enforcement to a phased schedule that starts in October 2026 in sandboxes and January 2027 in production.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Update API traffic to use the org's My Domain login URL instead of incorrect instanced URLs, starting with sandboxes in October 2026 and production in January 2027.

enforced.name: View Setup Audit Trail permission to access Setup Audit Trail
enforced.says: Control access to Setup Audit Trail with the dedicated View Setup Audit Trail permission. Admins can provide access without granting the broader View Setup permission, supporting the principle of least privilege.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Spring ’27
enforced.action: Assign the View Setup Audit Trail permission to users who need Setup Audit Trail access, instead of granting the broader View Setup permission.

enforced.name: Block Apex anonymous code execution from managed packages
enforced.says: To strengthen subscriber org security, block managed package session IDs from authenticating anonymous Apex code. If you enable this update, installed managed packages can no longer use UserInfo.getSessionId() to obtain a session ID and then use the session ID to execute anonymous Apex.
enforced.when: Scheduled to Be Enforced in Summer ’27
